summary: Focused retest of the iteration_5 fixes. Backend: new file test_iter6_leave_fixes.py (13 tests) plus the regression file test_leave_admin_console.py (30 tests). 42/43 pass. The one failure is a NEW HIGH bug: a sub-admin can approve or reject a leave request from someone outside their scope. Frontend: all 11 requested fixes checked in the browser and all work. Regression smoke passed.

critical.issue: No scope check. The sub-admin token approved Anita Shetty's request (Administration dept, outside their scope) and got 200 {ok:true}. admin_decide_leave checks only the self-request case and never calls ensure_in_scope(user, req['user_id']). The cancel endpoint does this check correctly, but decide does not. This is an IDOR: anyone who knows or guesses a leave_id can decide it.

minor.issue: Cancelling an approved request leaves decided_by_name and decision_note in place. The employee /leave list then shows 'cancelled by Test Admin' even when the employee cancelled it. Set a cancelled_by field (or clear decided_by_*) on cancel.
Uses ensure_in_scope, not ensure_manages_other, so a sub-admin can still reset their own face enrollment. Low risk, but it does not match the new self-edit rule.

ui_bugs.issue: The EDIT button still shows on the sub-admin's own row. Saving now returns 403 and shows an error toast. Hide it when emp.user_id === currentUserId and the viewer is not an admin.

issues: leave-pending-badge counts the manager's own pending request, which they cannot act on. Example: sub-admin badge 2 with only 1 actionable request. Consider excluding own requests or labelling the count.
From/To use the browser's native input type=date, not the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker.

action_items: HIGH: In admin_decide_leave, add `await ensure_in_scope(user, req['user_id'])` after the self-check. Then rerun tests/test_iter6_leave_fixes.py::TestSelfDecision::test_sub_admin_cannot_decide_out_of_scope.
Minor: when a request is cancelled, record who cancelled it (cancelled_by/cancelled_by_name) so the UI does not show the approver as the canceller.
Minor: hide the sub-admin's own EDIT (and RESET FACE) actions in TeamTab, and use ensure_manages_other for face reset.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_decide_leave is the only manager-only mutation on another user's data that has no ensure_in_scope check.
count_leave_days uses count_documents on holidays. This is safe only because add_holiday blocks duplicate dates. Keep that invariant, or use distinct('date').
Leave days are not recomputed when a holiday is added after a request already exists (by design, but worth noting).
verified_fixes: Self-decide returns 403 'You cannot decide on your own leave request' for both the sub-admin and the admin. The admin can decide the sub-admin's request; the sub-admin can decide Ravi's.
leave-pending-badge goes 4→3 after approve and 3→2 after reject, without switching tabs.
Dismissing the reject prompt makes no /decide call and the row stays pending.
own-request-{id} shows 'Your own request · another manager must decide' and no approve/reject buttons.
Sub-admin PATCH on their own shift/assignment returns 403; edits to Ravi return 200; the admin can edit their own shift.

Sub-admin cancelling Anita's request returns 403. The admin cancel returns 200 and logs leave_cancelled. The sub-admin can cancel Ravi's request. An employee can cancel their own request and gets 403 on someone else's.
A holiday inside the range is subtracted (3 days → 2). A holiday-only range returns 400 'Those dates are already company holidays'.
Quota message is 'Only 6 day(s) of Sick Leave left' (whole number).
PATCH leave-type with a duplicate code ('cl') returns 400.
At 390px, Team rows are fully readable with actions stacked below, and scrollWidth equals clientWidth (no overflow).
Smoke: Overview stats and charts load, the Live Map tab renders (empty state, nobody on duty), Team add/edit/remove works, employee /leave apply and cancel work.
seed_data_creation: Temporary session TEST_session_anita_iter6 for user_testemp02, removed in fixture teardown. All leave requests with reason TEST_iter6* deleted. TEST_ui_hire6 employee created and removed through the UI. Activity log entries remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_iter6_leave_fixes.py tests/test_leave_admin_console.py. The only expected failure until fixed is test_sub_admin_cannot_decide_out_of_scope. The iter6 file creates a temporary Anita session via pymongo. In Playwright, import asyncio before using it in dialog handlers. The selector [data-testid^='my-leave-'] also matches 'my-leave-list', so use exact ids.
rca of the issue: Repro: as Anita (user_testemp02) POST /api/leave/request. Then with the sub-admin token POST /api/admin/leave/{id}/decide {status:'approved'}. Result: 200, and the leave is approved by an out-of-scope manager. Root cause: server.py admin_decide_leave (~line 1199) never calls ensure_in_scope. Fix: add ensure_in_scope(user, req['user_id']).
